name: Carrier performance
prompt: Carrier performance: late delivery rate by carrier, monthly delay trends, and the regions hit worst

spec.title: Carrier performance: delays, late rates, and worst-hit regions

binding.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', delivered) AS month, AVG(delay_days) AS avg_delay_days FROM shipment_performance WHERE delivered IS NOT NULL AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE) AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE) AND delay_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

copy.title: Average delay by month
copy.caption: December shipments arrived 0.5 days early on average.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  carrier AS carrier,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS late_rate
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE delivered IS NOT NULL
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY late_rate DESC, carrier
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Late rate by carrier
copy.caption: DB Schenker had the highest late rate at 75%, while DHL and FedEx had none.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  region,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS late_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 1) AS avg_delay_days
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC, avg_delay_days DESC
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Late deliveries by region
copy.caption: Europe leads in late deliveries and delay days; North America and Latin America have no late shipments.
